The '''Southcentral Branch''' was an urban storm sewer that was part of the [[Eyar City Sewer]]. The Branch was located under the most densely built area of [[Eyar City]], and the system was poorly maintained and parts of the network had to fail before maintenance crews attended. The [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Sizinnian]] maintained a secluded [[Inner Sanctum]] in one of the branch's neglected secondary lines.<ref name="HS" />
